builds.howItPlays: You fill the battlefields with cheap units like Treasure Hunter, a 2-cost unit that leaves you a Gold token (which you can cash in for an extra rune) every time it moves, and you clear blockers with damage spells. Pyke's own ability pays 1 energy to pull one of your units off a battlefield back to your hand and gives you another Gold, so you can save a unit that was about to die or replay Ezreal, Prodigy to discard 1 and draw 2 again.
builds.whyYou: You like a board of small units that keep busy, moving between battlefields, picking up Gold and swapping out the cards in your hand. You don't mind giving up a unit's spot on a battlefield if bringing it home lets you play it again for more next turn, and you enjoy the choice Pyke gives you every turn about which unit to pull back. Games run into the middle turns and are decided by steady trades, not big gambles. If you'd rather win by getting a little more out of each card than your opponent does, this Pyke suits you.
builds.ratingNotes:
Change 2026-09-25: relabelled Control to Midrange. Coordinates moved from 3/4.5/7.5/5.5 to 6.5/5.5/6.5/4.5 (Pace +3.5, Stance +1, Complexity -1, Variance -1). The old numbers came from quotes in riftbound.gg and hextechanalytics guides, not from scored decks, and the current lists are cheap-unit midrange decks, not discard control. The deckListUrl moved from the bare /decks page to the style's display deck. I removed the old riftbound.gg and hextechanalytics guides because I couldn't confirm that either describes this list (riftbound.gg describes an older discard-and-bounce identity).
Scored decks (tools.ts style: Midrange 6.5/5.5/6.5/4.5, mean of 3; labels Midrange, Midrange, Midrange): Pyke - POST STACKED DECK BAN (HM01Yourself; 5 likes, 1,550 views) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/7e6be997-0f06-4eb8-af96-b8605bd2ef92 6.5/5.5/6.5/4 Midrange; pyikea (PieXF; measures the style) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/b477819e-3e49-4a00-b11c-de0f5c0293b0 6.5/6/6.5/5 Midrange; Mid Range Pyke - VEN (corruptwifi; measures the style) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/43fcfeba-d5ec-402f-a59c-86507f3b337d 6/5.5/6.5/5 Midrange. The style's tournament signal is Hartford RQ #8 (Mirru). That list ran now-illegal Stacked Deck/Aspirant's Climb, so the legal post-ban list is the display deck.
Adjustments (all three sheets): complexity +1, because the Legend's paid bounce is a decision every turn: save a unit, re-trigger an entry effect or make Gold. Formula and judgment were never 2 or more apart.
Deciding cards. Pace: 8-9 two-cost units (Treasure Hunter, Traveling Merchant, Tideturner, Noxus Hopeful) against only 2-4 cards costing 5+ (Baron Nashor, Ferrous Forerunner, Mindsplitter). Stance: about 14-15 pressure bodies (Treasure Hunter, Kai'Sa, Survivor, Pyke, Dockside Butcher, Darius, Trifarian) balanced by about 14 answers (Falling Star, Void Seeker, Star-Crossed, Gust, Piercing Light, Bewitching Spirit, Hard Bargain, Vex, Apathetic), so the balance term is about 0. Complexity: 7-10 reaction-speed cards (Hidden Tideturner and Pyke, Dockside Butcher, Star-Crossed, Gust, Switcheroo) plus setup and modes cards (Treasure Hunter's move trigger, Fizz, Trickster, Ezreal, Prodigy), and the Legend adjustment. Variance: no luck cards, 1-2 swing cards (Blighted Battleaxe), 10 removal and 7-9 cards that draw or loot (Traveling Merchant, Ezreal, Void Seeker, Kai'Sa). Few full playsets (23-45% 3-ofs) push it up a little.
Legend ability: [1], Exhaust: return a friendly unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand, then play a Gold gear token exhausted (it has "[Reaction] Kill this, Exhaust: [Add] a rune").
Also played: Kharox Reanimator Pyke, whose Kharox + Tornado Warrior Hidden engine scored Midrange 6/6/7.5/5.5 (https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/de1d850a-4e2c-4652-b8d8-1093bffd8892, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/29b3377a-6899-441e-8839-ef121d8f66db, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/a0584e7e-7968-4609-9482-88129a6d02ce). Treasure Trove Pyke, a Treasure Trove / Pack of Wonders / The List gear loop backed by Singapore RQ Best of Pyke, scored Midrange 6/6/7/4.5 (https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/d5da8b38-fe54-419c-ac41-d992d439e2d4, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/e2f779cd-0d4e-42cb-b788-3a1dded7360c, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/ebeddfa2-aa54-4b5d-87c4-2d52b25878dc). Tentacle Pyke, Martin Ivanov's 'The Lurking Pyke' with Up from the Deep, Illaoi and Monster Harpoon, scored Tempo 5.5/6/7/5 (https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/6266bad2-5113-494f-9a08-da60dfdd92f3, https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/f29aaa50-8339-4272-bc5b-8d3e541a303c). All three sit within about 1 of this Build on every Axis, so they fail Distinct and add their decks here.
Confidence: medium.
Reviewer check: there are no post-ban tournament lists yet (LA RQ runs 2026-09-25 to 27), so every strong signal predates the Stacked Deck ban. Re-check after LA whether Treasure Trove or Kharox lists pull away from this one.
